name: Book sales calls from website chat with Gemini, Groq fallback and Calendly

parameters.content:
## Book sales calls from website chat with Gemini, Groq fallback and Calendly

### How it works

This workflow powers a website chat that qualifies visitors, uses Gemini to generate replies, and falls back to Groq if Gemini fails. It parses hidden AI metadata to decide whether to continue chatting, offer Calendly slots, book a selected meeting, or save lead details. It responds to the visitor immediately while also logging conversations and notifying the team through Google Sheets, Gmail, and Lark.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Chat Webhook URL in the website chat widget and ensure the widget sends back the state flags returned from prior turns.
- Fill the Workflow Configuration node with company, assistant, host, meeting length, Calendly event type details, and Lark webhook URLs.
- Add valid API credentials or headers for Google Gemini, Groq, and Calendly in the HTTP Request nodes.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheets/tabs for booked meetings, failed bookings, and captured website leads.
- Connect Gmail credentials and verify the owner/lead notification recipients.
- Test all branches: normal chat, Gemini failure with Groq fallback, slot offering, successful booking, booking failure, and lead-detail capture.

### Customization

Adjust the AI prompt and parsing rules to change qualification questions, lead scoring, booking readiness criteria, and the hidden metadata fields expected from the chat widget.

## Receive chat request

Accepts incoming website chat messages and applies shared workflow settings used throughout the automation.

## Build AI prompt

Creates the stateless prompt for the assistant using the current message and state echoed back by the chat widget.

## Generate Gemini reply

Calls Gemini, normalizes its output into a common response shape, and checks whether the Gemini call failed.

## Fallback Groq reply

Runs the fallback Groq chat completion path and normalizes it to match the Gemini response format.

## Parse lead intent

Extracts hidden metadata from the AI response, detects lead state, and decides whether qualification is complete.

## Route lead status

Branches qualified visitors toward booking and routes non-booking conversations through website-capture handling.

## Offer Calendly slots

Fetches available Calendly times, formats the slot list, sends it to the visitor, and forwards the interaction for logging.

## Create Calendly booking

Attempts to book the selected Calendly meeting and checks whether the invitee creation succeeded.

## Confirm booked meeting

Builds a successful booking confirmation and returns it to the visitor without depending on downstream notifications.

## Notify booked meeting

Saves the booked meeting to Google Sheets, emails the owner, and posts a team notification to Lark.

## Handle booking failure

Interprets a Calendly booking rejection, formats guidance for the visitor, and sends the failure response.

## Log failed booking

Records unsuccessful booking attempts in Google Sheets for follow-up and troubleshooting.

## Send chat response

Formats and returns the regular conversational response when the visitor is not yet ready to book.

## Capture website lead

Stores captured website or lead details in Google Sheets and emails the lead information to the configured recipient.

## Post conversation log

Builds a plain-text transcript from completed response branches and posts it to Lark for team visibility.
